summary: Excellent deliverable. Script: comprehensive input validation, pure functional design for planCleanup(), clear policy application order (documented), proper error handling with specific messages, no gratuitous types. Workflow: correct triggers, least-privilege permissions (contents:read, actions:write), job dependencies, properly structured. Minor notes: dry-run flag behavior on push/pull_request/schedule triggers (empty, falls back to scenario default) could be clearer in comments; missing Bun install caching for CI speed.
